content.short: 1.country connects a Web3 name to a browsable Web2.country domain to unify users' digital identity.
content.description: 1.country enables users to claim a Web3 name with the .1 extension that also points to a browsable Web2 domain under the .country extension. Registrations provide both a Web3 identity and a Web2 website in a single transaction. It delivers an ICANN-approved top-level domain and supports 1-3 character premium Web3 names on Harmony's 2-second finality blockchain, with the corresponding Web2 domain provisioned in about 5 minutes, significantly faster than hours or days with traditional registrars.
